# agentnet

> A local network for Claude Code agents: names, a boss, task lists, messages and a live web view.

agentnet gives every Claude Code session a name, a boss, a task list and an inbox, and shows the whole team live on
your own machine. It runs on macOS and Linux and needs Claude Code, tmux and Bun. It is MIT licensed.

- Agents are real Claude Code sessions in tmux. There is no agent loop to write.
- Agents message each other, report to their boss and leave decision notes (trails) the next agent can search.
- The service listens on 127.0.0.1:3096 by default, has no login and refuses public addresses.
- agentnet starts real Claude Code sessions, so every agent uses your Claude Code usage. The web app shows what each one used.
- Not a framework, not an SDK, not a hosted service, not for Windows.
